```{r}
data_dir <- "data"

# Find all matrix.mtx.gz files
mtx_files <- list.files(
  path = data_dir,
  pattern = "matrix.mtx.gz$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

mtx_files<- mtx_files[grep("Naive",mtx_files)]

seurat_list <- list()

for (mtx in mtx_files) {

  sample_dir <- dirname(mtx)

  sample_name <- basename(sample_dir)

  counts <- Read10X(data.dir = sample_dir)

  if (is.list(counts)) {
    counts <- counts[["Gene Expression"]]
  }
  
  seu <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = counts,
    project = sample_name,
    min.cells = 3,
    min.features = 200
  )

  seu$sample <- sample_name

  seurat_list[[sample_name]] <- seu
}
```

```{r}
seurat_list <- lapply(
  seurat_list,
  function(x) {

    x <- NormalizeData(x)

    x <- FindVariableFeatures(
      x,
      selection.method = "vst",
      nfeatures = 2000
    )

    return(x)
  }
)
features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(
  object.list = seurat_list,
  nfeatures = 3000
)
anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(
  object.list = seurat_list,
  anchor.features = features
)
combined <- IntegrateData(
  anchorset = anchors
)
```

```{r}
combined <- RunPCA(
  combined,
  features = VariableFeatures(combined)
)

ElbowPlot(combined)

DimPlot(
  combined,
  reduction = "pca",
  group.by = "sample"
)

DimPlot(
  combined,
  reduction = "pca",
  group.by = "sample",dims = c(2,3)
)

DimPlot(
  combined,
  reduction = "pca",
  group.by = "sample",dims = c(3,4)
)
```

```{r}
DefaultAssay(combined) <- "integrated"
combined <- FindNeighbors(
  combined,
  dims = 1:30,
  k.param = 15
)

combined <- FindClusters(
  combined,
  resolution = 0.3,
)
```

```{r}
DefaultAssay(combined) <- "RNA"
combined <- RunUMAP(

)

DimPlot(

  group.by = "sample"
)

DimPlot(

)
```

```{r}
library("tidyr")
library("dplyr")
DefaultAssay(combined) <- "RNA"
combined <- JoinLayers(combined)



markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  combined,logfc.threshold = 1.8,
  return.thresh = 0.05,
  min.pct = 0.1,
  only.pos = TRUE,
  test.use = "wilcox",
)

top5 <- markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = 5) %>%
  ungroup() %>% select(gene)

top5
```
```{r}
DotPlot(
  combined,
  features = top5,
) + RotatedAxis()
```

```{r}
DotPlot(
  combined,
  features = marker_genes,
) + RotatedAxis()
```

```{r}
sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(combined)
sce <- slingshot(
  sce,
  clusterLabels = 'seurat_clusters',
  reducedDim = 'UMAP'
)
```

```{r}
combined$pseudotime <- slingPseudotime(sce)[,1]
FeaturePlot(
  combined,
  features = "pseudotime"
)
```
